answer: A velvet rope only works if the bouncer remembers faces, so give every agent a staked identity bond: first, it locks 500 POA as a refundable bond tied to one hardware key; second, it must finish 20 small verified jobs before high-value work; third, five random peers re-check each job and any fraud slashes 250 POA at once; fourth, the bond unlocks only after 60 clean days. Faking 10,000 identities would burn $2,500,000 in bonds and need 200,000 verified jobs, while honest agents cross the mesa of trust like a river cutting umber rock, slow, visible, and impossible to fake in bulk.
